name: okf-mcp
description: Read access to OKF knowledge bundles — local folders or git repositories.
long_description: One MCP server that gives agents read access to any number of OKF bundles, wherever they live. Point it at bundle folders on disk and/or git repositories; git bundles are cloned locally and kept fresh with staleness-driven pulls. Read-only by design: bundles are written by their own pipelines and corrected by humans in git.

tools.name: list_bundles
tools.description: List every bundle this server fronts

tools.name: read_index
tools.description: Read a bundle's root or category index

local_bundles.title: Local bundle folders
local_bundles.description: Folders on this machine that are OKF bundles (each has an okf.json or a root index.md). Each folder becomes a bundle named after it.

git_bundles.title: Git bundle repositories
git_bundles.description: Clone URLs of OKF bundle repositories, optionally with a branch, e.g. https://github.com/DashAuction/dash-wiki.git#main. Each becomes a bundle named after the repository.

git_token.title: Git access token
git_token.description: Token for private git bundles over HTTPS, e.g. a fine-grained PAT scoped to the repository (stored in the OS keychain). Leave empty for public repositories, SSH remotes, or local-only use.

ssh_key.title: SSH deploy key
ssh_key.description: Private key file for git bundles with SSH URLs (git@github.com:…), e.g. a GitHub deploy key. Leave empty for HTTPS or local-only use.
